Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I2, to be performed every three months as indicated by M3 in the title block
The first draft initiated 
by eng.
Haytham Abdul Mohsen Hemdan, 
tested by eng 
Mohamed El Bayaa, 
revised by EDEPC quality control eng Adel Abd- El kader El Nagar, accepted 
by eng El Sayed Attiah Abd El Maksood general director, and approved by eng.
Tarek Youssef Ali: Head Sector of
Ayoun Moussa PS.
This document accepted by 
eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and quality control general director & 
MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman: EDEPC 
planning & financial prediction head sector and supervisor of inspection & 
quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safty category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear the safety

The legal and regulator prescription for equipment 
 safety.
The dangers inherent to crane utilization.
The precautions to be observed before, during and 
 after utilization and / or intervention on the crane, may it be normal or 
 exceptional.
Adapted and efficient individual (helmet, harness) 
 or collective (markings, nets) protection facilities should be made available 
 to working personnel during the course of their duty, thus ensuring them with 
 maximum safety during utilization and/or intervention on the crane, may it be 
 normal or exceptional.
Cranes
The cranes and lifting 
accessories should be maintained in a good operating condition in compliance with 
the maintenance periodicities listed in the maintenance and test operations and 
adapted to the operating rates.
When a crane in perfect 
operating condition is stored for a period of more than 3 months, should be 
inspected from all points of view in accordance with the instructions given in 
the maintenance and check operations.
Following a malfunction 
or damage in the crane, should undergo the following operation:
Inspection to determine the exact cause of 
the incident and damage caused.
An adapted maintenance intervention
A complete correct operation check
